data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#r5): Before proposing any system, the user tells both flatmates they are done managing the chore question, then asks each separately what outcome they want, explicitly including decoupling options: separate shelves and cooking, domain ownership with swappable authority over each domain's standard, cost-split paid cleaning, or a time-limited agreement to tolerate more mess.
